subject: Input components that depends on each other

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Input components that depends on each other
parts:
Say I have two input components A and B.

I want A's value to change in response to a change in B, and I want B's value to change in response to a change in A. BUT once A has been updated by a change in B I don't want B to depend on A right away until there is another manual change in A, and vice versa.

This seems quite straight-forward to do in a non-reactive programming environment but seems a bit tough in Shiny. Is there a way to do that?

observe({
  input$A
  updatexxxInput(... something that depends on input$B)
})

observe({
  input$B
  updatexxxInput(... something that depends on input$A)
})


will not work as it introduces ciruclar dependencies where B is changed in response to A which then change A which then changes B ......

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Input components that depends on each other
parts:
That's a brain teaser !!


library(shiny)
runApp(
  list(ui=pageWithSidebar(
    headerPanel("Circular"), 
    sidebarPanel(
      numericInput("A", "A", 0),
      numericInput("B", "B", 2)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      verbatimTextOutput("see_Block")
    )
  ),
  server=function(input, output, session) {
    Block <- reactiveValues(start=-1, a=0, b=0)
    output$see_Block <- renderPrint({reactiveValuesToList(Block)})
    observe({
      input$A
      Block$start <- isolate(Block$start) + 1
      Block$b <- 1-isolate(Block$b)
    })
    observe({
      input$B
      Block$start <- isolate(Block$start) + 1
      Block$a <- 1-isolate(Block$a)
    })
    observe({
      if(isolate(Block$start)>0){
        a_new <- input$B^2  
        if(isolate(Block$a)==0){
          updateNumericInput(session, "A", value=a_new)
          Block$a <- 1-isolate(Block$a)
          Block$b <- 1-isolate(Block$b)
        }
      }
    })
    observe({
      if(isolate(Block$start)>0){
        b_new <- input$A+2
        if(isolate(Block$b)==0){
          updateNumericInput(session, "B", value=b_new)
          Block$b <- 1-isolate(Block$b)
          Block$a <- 1-isolate(Block$a)
        }
      }
    })
  })
)

We can avoid Block$start by changing the order :

    Block <- reactiveValues(a=0, b=0)

a_new <- input$B^2  
        if(isolate(Block$a)==0){
          updateNumericInput(session, "A", value=a_new)
          Block$a <- 1-isolate(Block$a)
          Block$b <- 1-isolate(Block$b)
        }
    })
    observe({

b_new <- input$A+2
        if(isolate(Block$b)==0){
          updateNumericInput(session, "B", value=b_new)
          Block$b <- 1-isolate(Block$b)
          Block$a <- 1-isolate(Block$a)
        }
    })
  })
